summary: OSpec 1.8.22 allows an explicitly accepted incomplete Goal to be force-archived when its retained pending Controller action contains only durably terminal items.
improved: Force archive now distinguishes live or incomplete Loop items from completed, failed, and expired terminal history.
fixed: Fixed force archive rejecting an awaiting-evidence Controller pointer whose only item had already failed and whose executor had exited.
Avoided requiring an observation tick that can fail when an obsolete temporary repair task no longer exists in the current task graph.
docs: Documented terminal pending-action eligibility and the unchanged non-bypassable safety boundary.
